Constraints
UQ DescriptionJob(description_set_id, generation) | UQ FeedbackJob(analysis_id, generation)
CHECK FeedbackRequest: job_id only + stage=descriptions, OR coaching_job_id only + stage=coaching.
Each request has exactly one owner across these two optional relationships; each job has at most one request.
Quota/reservation tables and operational timestamps are omitted from this focused view.
